caveats: Sea cells: 3299 of 3600 (finite SST on every target day). Baseline pools are the +-5-calendar-day windows around each 1992-01-01..2002-12-31 anchor date of a given day of year, so they include the halo days 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 (121 values per pool for every sea cell); day 60 (29 Feb) was set to the mean of days 59 and 61 before smoothing. Hot runs of >=5 days were identified first and only then joined across 1-2 non-hot day gaps; no such gap occurred in this period, so no joining was needed. No SST value exactly equalled its threshold.
